Med-Spa Agency — 24-Month Scenario Model

Med-Spa AI-Automation Agency — 24-Month Scenario Model

Solo founder · GoHighLevel · $500 entry (no setup) → $1,500 full system · Meta lead ads you close yourself. Month 1 = launch. All figures at the 45% upsell variant unless noted; 33% and 60% variants in the tables.

7 scenarios24 months churn 3%/mowinnable/metro ≈ 105 upsell 33/45/60%
The honest read — 5 things the math says
  1. One metro caps you at ~105 clients ≈ $97.0k/mo MRR. Aggressive, Team, Hybrid and Lean all converge to the same ceiling — heavier ad spend only changes how fast you get there, not the endpoint. Past ~90 active, extra spend in one metro is waste (the model auto-throttles it).
  2. To beat ~$100k MRR you change price or geography, not spend. Premium pricing lifts the same 105 clients to $134.3k/mo (+39%); three metros reach $282.4k/mo with 315 active.
  3. This business has almost no cash valley. With $0 setup, same-month billing and founder-delivered fulfillment, the deepest any scenario ever goes is ≈ $-1.7k — about one month of ad spend. Payback per client is ~1 month. You are not cash-constrained; you are throughput- and retention-constrained.
  4. The single input that moves month-24 MRR most is Both prices −20% ↔ +20% — swinging it moves the endpoint by $38.8k. Funnel efficiency (CPL, close, booking) barely moves the endpoint in a capped metro; it only moves the date you hit the cap.
  5. Churn compounds quietly: at 3%/mo you keep 69% left of a cohort at 12 months and only 48% left at 24. Every point of churn is worth more than a point of close rate once you're near the ceiling.

1 · Assumptions (edit these first)

Everything downstream is computed from this block. Change a number in model.py and rerun — every table and chart regenerates. These are defensible defaults, not your numbers; overwrite them the moment you have real data.

Funnel

InputBaselineNote / how it moves
Cost per lead (CPL)$25Meta lead ads, med-spa niche. Rises with metro saturation (→ ~$79 at the single-metro cap).
Lead → booked demo32%Booking funnel + 5-min callback. 28% sloppy / 36% dialed-in.
Cost per booked demo≈ $78= CPL ÷ (lead→booked). Derived, not independent.
Show rate70%Reminders before every demo. +3pts once a VA owns reminders.
Cost per show≈ $112= cost-per-booked ÷ show rate. Derived.
Close rate — 0 case studies20%Cold traffic, launch. This is the tax on being new.
Close rate — 3+ case studies35%Ramps in as you bank proof (½ of maturing clients → a usable case study).
Algorithm learning phase×1.4 CPL, month 1 onlyFirst 2 weeks Meta is guessing; month-1 leads cost ~40% more.
Creative fatigue / refresh+6% CPL per month, reset on refreshDisciplined = refresh every 2 mo; sloppy = every 4 mo (CPL drifts +24%).

Fixed business assumptions

InputBaselineNote
Entry price$500/moReactivation + review & referral. $0 setup fee (baseline).
Full-system price$1,500/moUpgrade tier — replaces entry, not additive.
Upsell take rate45% (33 / 45 / 60% modeled)Fires 2 months after close, once ROI dashboard shows $5k+ recovered.
Monthly churn3%Compounds. At 3%/mo you lose 31% of any cohort over 12 months, 52% over 24.
Tool cost$400 base + $30/active≈ $700/mo at 10 clients, ≈ $3,550/mo at 105 (GHL sub-accounts, Twilio, AI).
Solo fulfillment ceiling15 full-tier installsForces the first account-manager hire.
Solo support ceiling28 active clientsPast it, quality slips → +2%/mo overwhelm churn until you hire.
Founder-closer ceiling132 demos/mo (~6 closes/day)88 solo +22 with VA +22 with AM. Never binds — saturation caps leads first.
Addressable / metro300 med spas; 35% winnableRealistic ceiling ≈ 105 active clients per metro. You will not sign 90% of a metro.

4 · Per-scenario playbooks — phase actions, #1 bottleneck, numeric triggers

Phases are by client count, never dates. Every hire/expansion trigger is a number.

Ads-Only Conservative
Flat $2k/mo, no hires, one metro. The floor case — deliberately under-throttled.
0 → 5 clients
Ship 1 creative angle, 5-min callback on every lead, run 3–4 demos/day yourself, bank the first 3 case studies.
Bottleneck: Zero proof → 20% close.  ·  Trigger: —
5 → 15
Turn on review/referral automation for every client; screenshot every ROI-dashboard win.
Bottleneck: Your fulfillment hours.  ·  Trigger: Nothing hired by design.
15 → 30
You cross the 28-client solo support ceiling here → +2% overwhelm churn kicks in and caps you.
Bottleneck: Support load; you refuse to hire.  ·  Trigger: (Would-be) VA at 12; you skip it.
30+
Plateau ~39 active / ~$35k MRR. $2k/mo can't out-run churn on a bigger base.
Bottleneck: Under-spend + no leverage.  ·  Trigger: None — this path tops out.
Ads-Only Aggressive
Ramp spend $3k→$10k, hire on triggers, dominate one metro fast.
0 → 5
2–3 creative angles live, 5-min callback, 4–5 demos/day. Push to 3 case studies by month 3.
Bottleneck: Learning phase + no proof.  ·  Trigger: —
5 → 15
Raise spend to $5k at month 4. Systematize onboarding so installs don't eat every hour.
Bottleneck: Fulfillment time.  ·  Trigger: VA at 12 active ($1,200).
15 → 30
Spend $8k. Hire media buyer + first AM. Close rate now 35% (proof banked).
Bottleneck: Support crosses 28 → must hire.  ·  Trigger: Media buyer at $6k spend; AM at 25 active / 15 installs.
30+
Reach ~105 active by ~m15, then CPL saturates. Auto-throttle spend to ~$3k maintenance — full budget is now waste.
Bottleneck: Metro saturation (~105 cap).  ·  Trigger: Cut spend or expand: metro-2 trigger = 90 active.
Hybrid (Ads + Warm + Referrals)
$2.5k ads + 2 founder-outreach/mo + referral engine (8% of actives refer). Lowest blended CAC.
0 → 5
Ads + hand-pick 2 warm med spas/mo from your network. Referral automation on from client #1.
Bottleneck: Proof, but warm closes faster.  ·  Trigger: —
5 → 15
Referrals compound: 8% of actives send a signed client/mo at ~$0 CAC. Blended CAC falls to ~$200.
Bottleneck: Fulfillment time.  ·  Trigger: VA at 12 active.
15 → 30
Referral flywheel does the heavy lifting; ads become top-up. Cheapest cash build here.
Bottleneck: Support ceiling.  ·  Trigger: AM at 25 active / 15 installs.
30+
Same ~105 single-metro ceiling — but you got there on the least cash (worst drawdown only −$276).
Bottleneck: Metro saturation.  ·  Trigger: Metro-2 trigger = 90 active.
Scale-With-Team
Hire ahead into the ceiling so ops never caps you. Same endpoint as Aggressive, more resilient.
0 → 5
Standard launch. Document every SOP from day 1 so a VA can take it.
Bottleneck: Proof + your calendar.  ·  Trigger: —
5 → 15
Spend $6k at month 5. VA owns booking/reminders/CRM (show rate +3pts).
Bottleneck: Booking + admin drag.  ·  Trigger: VA at 12; media buyer at $6k spend.
15 → 30
AM owns fulfillment before the 15-install ceiling bites. Founder stays on closes only.
Bottleneck: Fulfillment ceiling (15 installs).  ·  Trigger: AM at 15 installs / 25 active.
30+
One AM per +30 actives keeps churn at baseline 3%. Endpoint ~105 / ~$97k, team cost ~$9–13k/mo.
Bottleneck: Metro saturation.  ·  Trigger: +1 AM per +30 active; metro-2 at 90.
Multi-Metro Expansion
Saturate metro 1, then open 2 and 3. The ONLY path past ~$100k MRR without raising price.
0 → 5
Win metro 1 exactly like Aggressive. Keep creatives/offers documented to clone into metro 2.
Bottleneck: Proof.  ·  Trigger: —
5 → 15
Build the team that makes a metro copy-pasteable (VA + first AM).
Bottleneck: Fulfillment.  ·  Trigger: VA at 12; AM at 25 active.
15 → 30 (per metro)
At 90 active in metro 1, open metro 2 with fresh $4–8k spend (CPL resets low). Dedicated AM per metro.
Bottleneck: Ops replication + your closing time.  ·  Trigger: Open metro-2 at 90 active; +1 AM per new metro.
30+ / 3 metros
m24 ≈ 315 active / ~$282k MRR. Now the founder-closer (132 demos/mo) is the next wall.
Bottleneck: Closer throughput across metros.  ·  Trigger: Hire a 2nd closer when demos booked > 120/mo; metro-3 at 90 active in metro 2.
Premium-Pricing
Raise entry $500→$750 and full $1,500→$2,000 once you hold 10 case studies. Same clients, +38% MRR.
0 → 5
Launch at standard price. Obsess over documented ROI ($5k+ recovered) — the case studies ARE the pricing power.
Bottleneck: Proof volume.  ·  Trigger: —
5 → 15
At 10 case studies (~month 6) raise both tiers. Close rate dips ~15% but revenue/client jumps.
Bottleneck: Nerve to raise price.  ·  Trigger: Price raise at 10 case studies.
15 → 30
Higher price = higher CAC tolerance and better-fit clients (lower churn in practice).
Bottleneck: Support ceiling.  ·  Trigger: AM at 25 active / 15 installs.
30+
Same ~105-client ceiling, but at ~$134k MRR vs $97k — the highest single-metro outcome.
Bottleneck: Metro saturation.  ·  Trigger: Metro-2 at 90 active.
Lean Cash-First
Reinvest only 35% of collections into ads (start $1k). Near-zero cash risk, ~same endpoint, a few months slower.
0 → 5
$1k/mo ads, 1 warm outreach/mo, referral automation on. Every dollar of profit is yours.
Bottleneck: Slow lead volume.  ·  Trigger: —
5 → 15
Ad budget self-funds as collections grow (caps at 3× the start). Drawdown never exceeds −$256.
Bottleneck: Growth rate, not cash.  ·  Trigger: VA at 12 active.
15 → 30
Compounds into the ceiling anyway — profit reinvestment is enough to fill one metro.
Bottleneck: Support ceiling.  ·  Trigger: AM at 25 active.
30+
m24 ≈ 105 active / ~$97k MRR — identical endpoint to Aggressive, reached ~4–6 months later, with the safest balance sheet of any path.
Bottleneck: Metro saturation.  ·  Trigger: Metro-2 at 90 active.

5 · Sensitivity — what moves month-24 MRR the most

Ranked by impact on month-24 MRR (biggest first):

  1. Both prices −20% ↔ +20%$77.6k → $116.3k  (Δ $38.8k)
  2. Winnable metro share 0.28 ↔ 0.42$77.6k → $116.3k  (Δ $38.8k)
  3. Upsell take-rate 33% ↔ 60%$85.1k → $111.8k  (Δ $26.7k)
  4. Monthly churn 4% ↔ 2%$96.0k → $97.9k  (Δ $1.8k)
  5. Lead→booked 26% ↔ 38%$97.0k → $97.0k  (Δ $0)
  6. Close rate (3+ CS) 28% ↔ 42%$97.0k → $97.0k  (Δ $0)
  7. Cost per lead $32 ↔ $18$97.0k → $97.0k  (Δ $0)

Read it this way: in a saturated single metro the endpoint is set by ceiling economics — upsell take-rate, churn, winnable market share and price. Funnel inputs (CPL, close, booking) rank at the bottom for the endpoint because they only change the month you hit 105, not the height of the ceiling. That flips in Multi-Metro, where you're never capped and funnel efficiency compounds. Practical takeaway: once you have proof, defend churn and push upsell/price before you touch the ad account.

6 · Setup-fee sensitivity — $0 vs $297

ScenarioWorst draw ($0)Worst draw ($297)Cash savedMonth-1 cash flow
Conservative$-1.6k$-805$839$-1.4k → $-805
Aggressive$-1.4k$-101$1.3k$-1.4k → $-101
Hybrid$-276$0$276$-276 → $1.4k

Multi-Metro$-1.7k$-2$1.7k$-1.7k → $-2

What removing the setup fee costs you: almost nothing in cash risk — a $297 fee shaves only ~$300–1,700 off an already-shallow drawdown and flips month 1 positive in most paths. The fee's real value isn't cash-flow; it's a commitment filter (fewer tire-kickers) traded against a lower close rate (a price objection at the worst moment — cold, zero case studies). At your close rates the $0-setup offer is the right call to maximize logo velocity; revisit a setup fee only after 3+ case studies when you can absorb the close-rate hit.

The non-negotiable daily loop (every scenario)

  • <5-min callback on 100% of leads — speed-to-lead is the highest-ROI habit; it's baked into the 32% book rate. Miss it and booked-rate falls first.
  • Confirm-and-remind every booked demo (24h + 2h + 15-min) — this is the 70% show rate. No-shows are the cheapest leak to fix.
  • Run your demos, then log every ROI-dashboard win — proof is what moves close rate 20% → 35% and unlocks the price raise at 10 case studies.

Model files: model.py (all assumptions + cohort engine) · report.py (charts + this page) · data/*.csv (per-scenario monthly output) · charts/*.png.

Rerun with real data: replace the funnel numbers in model.py → A (and the scenario ad-spend schedules) with your mentor's student numbers or your first 2 weeks of campaign data, then python3 report.py. Every table, chart and the honest read above recompute automatically. Nothing here is your data yet — these are defensible placeholders.

Cohort churn compounds monthly; upsell fires on survivors at cohort age 2; saturation and case-study effects read the prior month's state (no within-month circularity). Cash flow = collections − ad spend − tools − team; founder pay is not deducted (it's your take-home = cumulative cash).
